title: Arkret Morph Customer Risk Extension Example
description: Reference additive extension business-field schema for the morph.md customer_risk example, used by the ck.morph.schema_migrate transformation conformance vectors. It declares the optional fields a transformation migration may introduce (renamed score / backfilled priority) on top of ck.schema.morph.customer_risk.v1.
$comment: Logical schema id is ck.schema.morph.customer_risk.ext.v1 (dotted, used in schema_refs[]); the artifact file name uses hyphens (morph-customer-risk-ext.schema.json). Do not derive the id from the file name. This is a v1 additive extension profile, not a version bump of customer_risk.v1.
